corrections.reason: Post-freeze calculation correction: Vieta gives cosθ+tanθ=3. With c=cosθ,s=sinθ, c+s/c=3 implies c²+s=3c; the numerator 1+s−s² equals c²+s. Product gives a=1/4, so value=(3c)/(c/4)=12, choice ⑤. Original freeze preserved.

Post-freeze graph-reading/calculation correction from the already-opened student asset: f(x)=x²/16−4 and g(x)=3x/5+12/5 (line x-intercept −4 and graph intersection x=16). Solve f=g at x=−32/5,16 and f=−g at x=(−24±8√19)/5. Thus |f|<|g| on (−(24+8√19)/5,−32/5)∪((−24+8√19)/5,16), excluding x=−8,8 because logs are undefined. Integers: −11…−7 excluding −8 gives 4; 3…15 excluding 8 gives 12; total 16, choice ①. Original freeze preserved.

Post-freeze intersection-sum correction: for −1<u=(t−b)/a<0, the four roots over 0≤x≤2π sum to 5π; for 0<u<1 they sum to 3π. At t=b, g=5π; at lower endpoint b−a, g=5π/2; at upper endpoint b+a, g=3π/2 and is the minimum. Minimum at t=10 requires a+b=10. Taking b−a=2 and t=3 in the negative interior gives g(2)+g(3)=5π/2+5π=15π/2, so (a,b)=(4,6), ab=24, choice ⑤. Original freeze preserved.
